definition: Relative complex L2 error to measured mean-removed four-frame quadrature times one unit linear phase with fixed half-array origin. Adjacent weighted cross-product phases estimate the plane without object-pixel division. Frequencies modulo 2pi radians/pixel.
reference_type: Public measured quadrature and phase-ramp gauge; no physical truth or finite-search output matching
threshold_provenance: Declared relative complex-field numerical tolerance; float32/float64 controls and alternate gauge tests recorded in validation.
